newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells record 380.1 trln lira of 287-d bills.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells record 380.1 trln lira of 287-d bills.

text.p: The Turkish treasury sold a record 380.1 trillion lira of 287-day bills at 112.86 percent yield in an auction on Tuesday, up sharply from 103.44 percent in the previous 287-day bill auction on February 7.
The previous record issue was 373.3 trillion lira of 399-day bonds sold in the Treasury's January 7 auction.
Bids for today's auction totalled 553 trillion lira, the central bank said.
